t.zh: 这一关有红、蓝两把钥匙，也有红门和蓝门。穿过一扇门之前，必须捡过同色的钥匙。
t.en: This level has a red key and a blue key, and red and blue doors. Before going through a door, you must have picked up the key of its colour.

t.zh: 一条路线手里的钥匙有四种可能：都没有、只有红、只有蓝、都有。表就叠成 4 层，每层装着「手里正好有这几把钥匙」的路线。
t.en: A route can be holding its keys in four ways: none, only red, only blue, or both. So the table is stacked 4 layers deep, each holding the routes “carrying exactly these keys”.

goal.zh: 只能往右或往下走。算出合法路线的条数：四层终点的数加起来。
goal.en: Only right or down. Work out the number of valid routes: the end cells of the four layers, added up.

how.zh: 每一格把四层都算一遍。
how.en: Every cell works out all four layers.

hints.en: Try the board from <level-ref to="keydoor"></level-ref> first.

body.zh: 两把钥匙，四种可能：都没有、只有红、只有蓝、都有。每种可能一层，表就有了 4 层，电路板却一点没变。
body.en: Two keys, four possibilities: none, only red, only blue, both. One layer for each, so the table has 4 layers, yet the circuit board didn’t change at all.
